verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says SSL is provisioned automatically from the moment you deploy, so the core TLS capability is first-party. Nothing in the evidence says the certificates are free, automatically renewed, or cover custom and wildcard domains. Missing for 10: documented free certificate issuance, automatic renewal, custom-domain coverage, wildcard certificate support, in-depth docs and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards

citations.quote: Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.
